verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly markets syncing with QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite plus 'AI-powered automations to close your books faster,' and offers bill-pay AI, auto-attached receipts, and a rich accounting-relevant API (transactions, categories, statements, AR). However, no independent or hands-on evidence validates the AI close-automation claim's effectiveness, and community feedback focuses on cards/transfers rather than books-closing automation.
